Name: Miyagi-Do Dojo Banners for CF
Author: SterlingDraven
Description:
[center][/center][center][size=4][b]Miyagi-Do Dojo Rule Banners﻿[/b][/size]

[size=3][img]https://i.imgur.com/ssV6tAL.png[/img]﻿[/size]
[b]"My dojo, my rules."[/b][size=3]﻿[/size]

[size=3]I wanted a tea room, but also wanted a dojo. And every dojo has to have rules, right?[/size]

[size=1]I know, they're kind of scrunched, but in my defense, it's difficult to try for accuracy, when you're limited to a max height of 48 pixels...[/size]


[color=#ffe599][size=4]Installation:[/size][/color]
[size=3]- Unzip to your mods folder and run the game[/size]
[size=3]- Like with any CF mod, you'll of course need the Furniture Catalogue from Robin.[/size]

[color=#ffe599][size=4]Bug and Issues:[/size][/color]
[size=3]Leave a report, and I'll see what I can do.[/size]
[/center]
